agents.title: Chief incident evidence orchestrator
agents.description: Coordinate the incident investigation, assign scoped evidence tasks, check every claim for provenance, and route operational decisions to human owners.

agents.title: Multi-source UTC timeline
agents.description: Normalize mixed time zones, order observed events, detect gaps and preserve source IDs without changing meaning.

agents.title: Trace and span investigations
agents.description: Link known trace/span identifiers across services, reject speculative joins and identify unresolved trace gaps.
agents.backing: guidance-only (traceId and spanId are captured by the CLI; joins are manual)

agents.title: Deployment and change analysis
agents.description: Compare release/change windows with observed alerts, show temporal relationships and competing pre-existing incident signals.

agents.title: Competing explanations and falsification
agents.description: Propose multiple candidate explanations, cite supporting and contradictory events, request diagnostics, never declare unobserved root cause.

agents.title: Blameless incident learning
agents.description: Produce stakeholder-reviewable postmortems, impact timelines, detection gaps, evidence and corrective actions without assigning individual blame.

agents.title: Metric and SLO evidence
agents.description: Identify p50/p95/p99, saturation, error budgets and traffic context when supplied; mark absent metric coverage and avoid unsupported calculations.

agents.title: Log integrity and signal extraction
agents.description: Parse log formats, normalize severity and correlate within permitted scope; minimize sensitive log retention.

agents.title: Alert quality and priority
agents.description: Separate real impact indicators from noisy alerts and duplicates; never suppress or disable alerting automatically.

agents.title: Dependency and provider context
agents.description: Map known upstream/downstream service relationships from supplied evidence; mark assumptions, vendor statuses and undocumented dependencies.
agents.backing: guidance-only (the CLI detects dependency wording, not topology)

agents.title: Impact and customer scope
agents.description: Identify affected services, regions and workflows where observed; do not infer customer count or financial impact without inputs.
agents.backing: guidance-only (the CLI lists affected services; customer impact needs external data)

agents.title: Safe runbook guidance
agents.description: Find appropriate documented incident runbooks, classify commands by permissions and side effects; default to recommendation only.
agents.backing: guidance-only (templates and workflows are provided; matching is manual)

agents.title: Provenance and reproducibility
agents.description: Validate event IDs, file hashes, report integrity, evidence links and decision logs; block ungrounded or tampered claims.

agents.title: Privacy, secret minimization and redaction
agents.description: Review PII, tokens, auth details, customer data and incident exports, fail safely when redaction is incomplete and require permission before outbound sharing.

agents.title: Incident communications
agents.description: Draft clear internal/status-page updates with verified impact and uncertainty, never transmit externally without explicit approval.
agents.backing: guidance-only (drafts text; the CLI sends nothing)

agents.title: Service level objectives and error budgets
agents.description: Analyze supplied SLI/SLO series and burn rates, show sampling gaps and only report observed measurements.
agents.backing: guidance-only (the CLI exposes raw series; burn-rate math needs supplied targets)

agents.title: Human-controlled mitigation and recovery
agents.description: Develop non-destructive diagnostic and rollback checklists; do not execute production actions, changes, or restarts.

agents.title: Independent methodology and security audit
agents.description: Review causality language, timing assumptions, privacy, role boundaries, evidence completeness and reproducibility.

agents.title: Cross-IDE Agent Skills compatibility
agents.description: Maintain portable SKILL.md contracts, project-local installs and tested host-specific invocation instructions. Untested is not unsupported or verified.

agents.title: Read-only telemetry connector architecture
agents.description: Plan least-privilege observability connectors with pagination, bounded query windows, safe auth, masking, retry budgets and audit logs.
agents.backing: guidance-only (no live connector exists; see docs/TOOL_AND_PLUGIN_CATALOG.md)
